status: Prospective, budget-limited exploratory model study; not externally preregistered
model_selection: auto; stop and report if any response is not gpt-6-luna
design: 2^(4-1) resolution-IV half fraction, observation=depth*branching*width in coded +/-1 levels; main effects are orthogonal but aliased with three-factor interactions, and two-factor interactions are mutually aliased
limitations: Eight configuration combinations, each evaluated with two paired task seeds
Two seed clusters are descriptive; no reliable confirmatory confidence intervals
Main effects may be confounded with three-factor interactions; two-factor interactions are mutually aliased
One routed model and one synthetic task family; no reasoning-budget intervention
The half fraction estimates main effects under assumptions and is not a full factorial
primary_outcome: Complete all eight operations without an invalid action
failure_protocol: Invalid JSON, invalid action schema, or invalid environment action terminates the episode without retry

budget.cap_note: The CLI requires a minimum 30-AI-credit per-invocation cap; it is soft and not the cumulative study budget. A pre-call cumulative guard at 26.75 leaves margin below the 27.0 project stop. Copilot reports AI credits, not dollars. Remaining account quota is unavailable, so the 35%-quota rule cannot be verified.

analysis: Report raw cell outcomes and paired seed contrasts; do not make confirmatory or generalization claims
budget_amendment_before_inference: The CLI rejected a 0.5-AI-credit per-invocation cap before any model request; no inference was run. The accepted soft cap is 30 per invocation, with a pre-call cumulative stop at 26.75 AI credits and a project stop at 27.0.
budget_amendment_during_run: On 2026-11-01, the user explicitly overrode the earlier USD 15 ceiling for this experiment and authorized continued Copilot-credit usage while accepting that the dollar equivalent and remaining account quota cannot be verified. The runner's cumulative AI-credit stop remains in effect. After 15 episodes had completed and their descriptive outcomes were viewed, the user authorized resuming to complete the prespecified 16th episode; the design and condition were unchanged.
post_run_analysis_amendment: The analyzer accepts repeated gpt-6-luna entries in per-decision route logs and validates that their unique set contains only the prespecified model. This corrects an initial validation failure; no episode data or outcome definitions were changed.
